generation_method.name: Simulated Annealing with Enhanced Exploration and Local Search
generation_method.details: The solution was generated using a multi-run Simulated Annealing algorithm, followed by a local search phase. The primary goal was to improve exploration of the solution space and refine the best candidates. Each SA run started with a randomly generated polynomial. The neighbor generation strategy was enhanced to allow for both single and double coefficient flips. The polynomial evaluation for the peak-to-RMS ratio was performed using the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) on 2^18 (262,144) points on the unit circle for higher accuracy. The RMS value is sqrt(N+1) where N=50 (51 coefficients). After the SA phase, a deterministic hill-climbing local search was applied to the best solution found, iteratively flipping single coefficients until no further improvement could be made.

parameters.neighbor_generation_strategy: Randomly choose between single-flip (70% probability) and double-flip (30% probability)
parameters.initial_solution_source: Randomly generated polynomial for each SA run

generation_method.optimization_strategy: Multiple SA runs with random initializations. Enhanced neighbor generation. Applied a post-SA local search. Accepted better solutions. Accepted worse solutions with probability exp(-delta_ratio / temperature).
generation_method.computational_resources: Python 3.x with NumPy. Run on a multi-core CPU for approximately 12 hours, utilizing parallel processing for multiple SA runs.
